title: Refresh every project's stale .dashboard/CLAUDE.md (still says edit board.json)
notes: seedBoardDirectory never overwrites, so 23 project .dashboard/CLAUDE.md files still tell agents to edit board.json by hand; the board guard now refuses that edit. Make the app rewrite the file it owns when its text changes (or stop writing it and rely on the session prompt), and delete the stale copies. Found by the md audit, 2026-11-17.

comments.body: Pull request #317 opened: Rewrite the seeded .dashboard docs whenever they are not the current text https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/317

Converged, ready to merge. Before the loop: the card file was reverted to main's copy, and the rewritten seeded .dashboard docs are now committed and pushed to origin's default branch by the board sync where git tracks them (board-decision-8 updated). A seeded file that is a symlink is never written. Review loop: 3 rounds, floor-addressed, 8 findings fixed, 0 rejected, no conflict with main. Its last fix (README wording, low) had no re-review after it. CI 5/5 green on 5b9fcb4c. Caveat: a checkout on another branch made before the new text reached main shows the doc as modified until that branch takes main's copy.

A board read now rewrites a stale seeded doc only in a checkout on origin's default branch (or outside git); a feature-branch worktree keeps its copy until it merges main, so the worker's merge is not blocked. A missing doc is still written anywhere. The answer is kept a minute per folder so a stale branch does not spawn git on every read. board-decision-8 updated. Tests added (decision module, cache, git-level worktree case). Head 3c098883, CI 3/3 green. Ready to merge.

Re-review of the commits since 5b9fcb4c. New findings: 1 medium, 2 low. Both lows are fixed in c6d2a8cb: baseBranch has its comment back, and a shared gitNowOrNull replaces the duplicated wrapper. The step-4 thread was verified fixed and resolved. Open, for the owner: the medium. Where there is no origin default branch (no origin remote, or a default other than main or master), a stale doc is never rewritten and the sync cannot push it either. Head c6d2a8cb, CI green.
